title: Reviews With Photos
text:
## Reviews With Photos
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000025177
Users can leave reviews on the members’ profile pages by default. This add-on, however, expands this functionality by allowing users to upload up to 5 images when leaving a review.
This functionality is completely mobile-friendly as well. Users can upload images from their smartphones and tablets in addition to their computers.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Reviews With Photos Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On
Go to Finance - Membership Plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086467582/original/gnUz-xtpO-ppWUI4KJmj51CsHAGRGPTj7A.png?1608237491 | alt: ]
Select the membership level that this add-on will be activated for:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086467715/original/aWZDPWTZaSOkO1B0c4lX73J16L-O2Kr-dg.png?1608237698 | alt: ]
Next click on the Profile Page tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086467744/original/vXs_ujkYDAd6mEMZIunk16gfYTbRHTqk8g.png?1608237769 | alt: ]
Scroll down until the Member Review Settings shows and allow/disable image uploads with reviews:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086467769/original/-TgN72SzkIOk3phWxiNgalaM2r4jJ3dBTQ.png?1608237840 | alt: ]
This will allow members to upload images when submitting a review for members:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091956092/original/eb05dlPnF07qL93F-uw-_x3O2IlJtLLVcg.gif?1619658262 | alt: ]
This is how it will display on the member's profile:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086468856/original/l1ugS4y2hfNoVpXiO2VUpbtIMS7q6ktBzA.png?1608239741 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086468896/original/9_mx5bbvlKnn0SJS4MdBeRq8NsWfNP3n1g.png?1608239792 | alt: ]
Note: This feature will only work for logged in members, not for regular users.
